field.name: PF_INIT_MODE
field.description: Prefilter Initialization Mode

enumeratedValue.name: PF_INIT_MODE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Do not pre-fill any prefilter taps. The first sample written to the ASRC corresponds to the highest index prefilter filter tap.

enumeratedValue.name: PF_INIT_MODE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Replicate the first sample to fill the right half of the prefilter.

enumeratedValue.name: PF_INIT_MODE_2
enumeratedValue.description: Zero fill the right half of the prefilter.

field.name: RS_INIT_MODE
field.description: Resampler Initialization Mode

enumeratedValue.name: RS_INIT_MODE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Do not pre-fill any resampler taps. The first sample output from the prefilter corresponds to the highest index resampling filter tap.

enumeratedValue.name: RS_INIT_MODE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Replicate the first prefilter output sample to fill the right half of the resampler.

enumeratedValue.name: RS_INIT_MODE_2
enumeratedValue.description: Fill the right half of the re-sampler with zeros.

field.name: PF_STOP_MODE
field.description: Pre-Filter Stop Mode

enumeratedValue.name: PF_STOP_MODE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Replicate the last sample input to the ASRC_WRFIFO for the left-half of the pre-filter on RUN_STOP.

enumeratedValue.name: PF_STOP_MODE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Zero-Fill the left-half of the pre-filter on RUN_STOP.

field.name: RS_STOP_MODE
field.description: Resampler Stop Mode

enumeratedValue.name: RS_STOP_MODE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Replicate the final prefilter output for the left-half of the resampler on RUN_STOP.

enumeratedValue.name: RS_STOP_MODE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Zero-Fill the left-half of the resampler on RUN_STOP.

enumeratedValue.name: ATTEIE_1

enumeratedValue.description: Interrupt enabled. Generate an interrupt if TIDR[ITTE] is set. Write 1 to this bit will clear bit TIDR[ITTE].

field.name: ATTE

field.name: SRS
field.description: Software Reset Signal

field.name: WDA

field.description: Software Reset Extension. Required to be set to 1 when used in conjunction with the Software Reset Signal (SRS).

enumeratedValue.description: This bit must be set to 1.

field.name: WDW
field.description: Watchdog Disable for Wait

field.name: WT
field.description: Watchdog Time-out Field

field.name: WSR

enumeratedValue.description: Write to the Watchdog Service Register (WDOG_WSR).

enumeratedValue.name: WSR_43690
enumeratedValue.description: Write to the Watchdog Service Register (WDOG_WSR).

field.name: SFTW
field.description: Software Reset

enumeratedValue.name: SFTW_0
enumeratedValue.description: Reset is not the result of a software reset.

enumeratedValue.name: SFTW_1
enumeratedValue.description: Reset is the result of a software reset.

field.name: TOUT
field.description: Timeout. Indicates whether the reset is the result of a WDOG timeout.

enumeratedValue.name: TOUT_0
enumeratedValue.description: Reset is not the result of a WDOG timeout.

enumeratedValue.name: TOUT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Reset is the result of a WDOG timeout.

field.name: POR
field.description: Power On Reset. Indicates whether the reset is the result of a power on reset.

enumeratedValue.name: POR_0
enumeratedValue.description: Reset is not the result of a power on reset.

enumeratedValue.name: POR_1
enumeratedValue.description: Reset is the result of a power on reset.

field.name: WICT
field.description: Watchdog Interrupt Count Time-out (WICT) field determines, how long before the counter time-out must the interrupt occur

enumeratedValue.name: WICT_0
enumeratedValue.description: WICT[7:0] = Time duration between interrupt and time-out is 0 seconds.

enumeratedValue.name: WICT_1
enumeratedValue.description: WICT[7:0] = Time duration between interrupt and time-out is 0.5 seconds.

enumeratedValue.name: WICT_4
enumeratedValue.description: WICT[7:0] = Time duration between interrupt and time-out is 2 seconds (Default).

enumeratedValue.name: WICT_255
enumeratedValue.description: WICT[7:0] = Time duration between interrupt and time-out is 127.5 seconds.

field.name: WTIS
field.description: Watchdog Timer Interrupt Status bit will reflect the timer interrupt status, whether interrupt has occurred or not

field.name: WIE
field.description: Watchdog Timer Interrupt enable bit

field.name: PDE

enumeratedValue.description: Power Down Counter of WDOG is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: PDE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Power Down Counter of WDOG is enabled (Default).

field.description: Monotonic Counter Hard Lock When set, prevents any writes (increments) to the MC Registers and MC_ENV bit

field.description: General Purpose Register Hard Lock When set, prevents any writes to the GPR

field.name: LPWUI_EN
field.description: LP Wake-Up Interrupt Enable This interrupt line should be connected to the external pin and is intended to inform the external chip about an SNVS_LP event (MC rollover, SRTC rollover, or time alarm )

field.description: Dumb PMIC Enabled When set, software can control the system power

field.name: DEBOUNCE

field.name: ON_TIME
field.description: The ON_TIME field is used to configure the period of time after BTN is asserted before pmic_en_b is asserted to turn on the SoC power

field.name: PK_OVERRIDE

register.name: A53CORE0_CTRL
register.description: GPC PGC Control Register for PGC CPUs

field.name: PCR
field.description: Power ControlPCR must not change from power-down request (pdn_req) assertion until the target subsystem is completely powered up

enumeratedValue.name: PCR_0
enumeratedValue.description: Do not switch off power even if pdn_req is asserted.

enumeratedValue.name: PCR_1
enumeratedValue.description: Switch off power when pdn_req is asserted.

field.name: L2RSTDIS
field.description: After scu pdn_req, count this value to assert A53 l2rstdis to 1'b1, it will be clear automatically once any of A53 core0/core1/core2/core3 is wakeup Can't be programmed to zero (This register control only for SCU Type PGC)

field.name: DFTRAM_TCD1
field.description: After scu pdn_req, count this value to assert A53 dftram to 1'b1 Can't be programmed to zero (This register control only for SCU Type PGC)

field.name: L2RETN_TCD1_TDR
field.description: After scu pdn_req, count this value to assert A53 l2retn to 1'b0 Can't be programmed to zero (This register control only for SCU Type PGC)

field.name: MEMPWR_TCD1_TDR_TRM
field.description: After scu pdn_req, count this value to assert A53 mempwr to 1'b1 Can't be programmed to zero (This register control only for SCU Type PGC)

register.name: A53CORE0_PUPSCR
register.description: GPC PGC Up Sequence Control Register

field.name: SW
field.description: After a power-up request (pup_req assertion), the PGC waits a number of clocks equal to the value of SW before asserting switch_b SW must not be programmed to zero

field.name: SW2ISO
field.description: After asserting switch_b, the PGC waits a number of clocks equal to the value of SW2ISO before negating isolation

register.name: A53CORE0_PDNSCR
register.description: GPC PGC Down Sequence Control Register

field.name: ISO
field.description: After a power-down request (pdn_req assertion), the PGC waits a number of clocks equal to the value of ISO before asserting isolation ISO must not be programmed to zero

field.name: ISO2SW
field.description: After asserting isolation(by pdn_req assertion), the PGC waits a number of clocks equal to the value of ISO2SW before negating switch_b ISO2SW must not be programmed to zero

field.name: PSR
field.description: Power status

enumeratedValue.name: PSR_0
enumeratedValue.description: The target subsystem was not powered down for the previous power-down request.

enumeratedValue.name: PSR_1
enumeratedValue.description: The target subsystem was powered down for the previous power-down request.

field.name: L2RETN_FLAG
field.description: L2 Retention Flag Software should write "1" to clear this flag after A53 is wakeup from L2 retention mode, otherwise it will always keep to 1 (This register control only for SCU Type PGC)

enumeratedValue.name: L2RETN_FLAG_0
enumeratedValue.description: A53 is not wakeup from L2 retention mode.

enumeratedValue.name: L2RETN_FLAG_1
enumeratedValue.description: A53 is wakeup from L2 retention mode.

field.name: ALLOFF_FLAG
field.description: All-off flag

enumeratedValue.name: ALLOFF_FLAG_0
enumeratedValue.description: A53 is not wakeup from ALL_OFF mode.

enumeratedValue.name: ALLOFF_FLAG_1
enumeratedValue.description: A53 is wakeup from ALL_OFF mode.

field.name: PUP_CLK_DIV_SEL
field.description: Clock divider select for the clock of power up counter(count_clk is 32KHz for CPU/SCU type PGC, ipg_clk(66MHz) for MIX/PU Type PGC)

field.name: L2RSTDIS_DEASSERT_CNT
field.description: Count this value to de-assert L2RSTDISABLE to LOW after CPU0 or CPU1 power up This value can't be programmed to zero (This register control only for SCU Type PGC)

field.name: ARDFEN
field.description: Enable AHB bus Read Access to IP RX FIFO.

enumeratedValue.name: ARDFEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: IP RX FIFO should be read by IP Bus. AHB Bus read access to IP RX FIFO memory space will get bus error response.

enumeratedValue.name: ARDFEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: IP RX FIFO should be read by AHB Bus. IP Bus read access to IP RX FIFO memory space will always return data zero but no bus error response.

field.name: ATDFEN
field.description: Enable AHB bus Write Access to IP TX FIFO.

enumeratedValue.name: ATDFEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: IP TX FIFO should be written by IP Bus. AHB Bus write access to IP TX FIFO memory space will get bus error response.

enumeratedValue.name: ATDFEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: IP TX FIFO should be written by AHB Bus. IP Bus write access to IP TX FIFO memory space will be ignored but no bus error response.

field.name: SERCLKDIV
field.description: The serial root clock could be divided inside FlexSPI . Refer Clocks chapter for more details on clocking.

field.name: HSEN
field.description: Half Speed Serial Flash access Enable.

enumeratedValue.name: HSEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disable divide by 2 of serial flash clock for half speed commands.

enumeratedValue.name: HSEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enable divide by 2 of serial flash clock for half speed commands.

field.name: DOZEEN
field.description: Doze mode enable bit

enumeratedValue.name: DOZEEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Doze mode support disabled. AHB clock and serial clock will not be gated off when there is doze mode request from system.

enumeratedValue.name: DOZEEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Doze mode support enabled. AHB clock and serial clock will be gated off when there is doze mode request from system.

field.name: COMBINATIONEN
field.description: This bit is to support Flash Octal mode access by combining Port A and B Data pins (A_DATA[3:0] and B_DATA[3:0]).

field.name: SCKFREERUNEN
field.description: This bit is used to force SCLK output free-running. For FPGA applications, external device may use SCLK as reference clock to its internal PLL. If SCLK free-running is enabled, data sampling with loopback clock from SCLK pad is not supported (MCR0[RXCLKSRC]=2).

field.name: LEARNEN
field.description: This bit is used to enable/disable data learning feature. When data learning is disabled, the sampling clock phase 0 is always used for RX data sampling even if LEARN instruction is correctly executed.

field.name: IPGRANTWAIT
field.description: Time out wait cycle for IP command grant.

field.name: AHBGRANTWAIT
field.description: Timeout wait cycle for AHB command grant.

field.name: AHBBUSWAIT
field.description: AHB Read/Write access to Serial Flash Memory space will timeout if not data received from Flash or data not transmitted after AHBBUSWAIT * 1024 ahb clock cycles, AHB Bus will get an error response

field.name: SEQWAIT
field.description: Command Sequence Execution will timeout and abort after SEQWAIT * 1024 Serial Root Clock cycles

field.name: CLRAHBBUFOPT
field.description: This bit determines whether AHB RX Buffer and AHB TX Buffer will be cleaned automatically when FlexSPI returns STOP mode ACK. Software should set this bit if AHB RX Buffer or AHB TX Buffer will be powered off in STOP mode. Otherwise AHB read access after exiting STOP mode may hit AHB RX Buffer or AHB TX Buffer but their data entries are invalid.

enumeratedValue.name: CLRAHBBUFOPT_0
enumeratedValue.description: AHB RX/TX Buffer will not be cleaned automatically when FlexSPI return Stop mode ACK.

enumeratedValue.name: CLRAHBBUFOPT_1
enumeratedValue.description: AHB RX/TX Buffer will be cleaned automatically when FlexSPI return Stop mode ACK.

field.name: CLRLEARNPHASE
field.description: The sampling clock phase selection will be reset to phase 0 when this bit is written with 0x1. This bit will be auto-cleared immediately.

field.name: SAMEDEVICEEN
field.description: All external devices are same devices (both in types and size) for A1/A2/B1/B2.

enumeratedValue.name: SAMEDEVICEEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: In Individual mode, FLSHA1CRx/FLSHA2CRx/FLSHB1CRx/FLSHB2CRx register setting will be applied to Flash A1/A2/B1/B2 separately. In Parallel mode, FLSHA1CRx register setting will be applied to Flash A1 and B1, FLSHA2CRx register setting will be applied to Flash A2 and B2. FLSHB1CRx/FLSHB2CRx register settings will be ignored.

enumeratedValue.name: SAMEDEVICEEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: FLSHA1CR0/FLSHA1CR1/FLSHA1CR2 register settings will be applied to Flash A1/A2/B1/B2. FLSHA2CRx/FLSHB1CRx/FLSHB2CRx will be ignored.

field.name: SCKBDIFFOPT
field.description: B_SCLK pad can be used as A_SCLK differential clock output (inverted clock to A_SCLK). In this case, port B flash access is not available. After changing the value of this field, MCR0[SWRESET] should be set.

enumeratedValue.name: SCKBDIFFOPT_0
enumeratedValue.description: B_SCLK pad is used as port B SCLK clock output. Port B flash access is available.

enumeratedValue.name: SCKBDIFFOPT_1
enumeratedValue.description: B_SCLK pad is used as port A SCLK inverted clock output (Differential clock to A_SCLK). Port B flash access is not available.

field.name: RESUMEWAIT
field.description: Wait cycle (in AHB clock cycle) for idle state before suspended command sequence resumed.

field.name: APAREN
field.description: Parallel mode enabled for AHB triggered Command (both read and write) .

enumeratedValue.name: APAREN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Flash will be accessed in Individual mode.

enumeratedValue.name: APAREN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Flash will be accessed in Parallel mode.

field.name: CACHABLEEN
field.description: Enable AHB bus cachable read access support.

enumeratedValue.name: CACHABLEEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. When there is AHB bus cachable read access, FlexSPI will not check whether it hit AHB TX Buffer.

enumeratedValue.name: CACHABLEEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. When there is AHB bus cachable read access, FlexSPI will check whether it hit AHB TX Buffer first.

field.name: BUFFERABLEEN
field.description: Enable AHB bus bufferable write access support. This field affects the last beat of AHB write access, refer for more details about AHB bufferable write.

enumeratedValue.name: BUFFERABLEEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. For all AHB write access (no matter bufferable or non-bufferable ), FlexSPI will return AHB Bus ready after all data is transmitted to External device and AHB command finished.

enumeratedValue.name: BUFFERABLEEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. For AHB bufferable write access, FlexSPI will return AHB Bus ready when the AHB command is granted by arbitrator and will not wait for AHB command finished.

field.name: PREFETCHEN
field.description: AHB Read Prefetch Enable.

field.name: READADDROPT
field.description: AHB Read Address option bit. This option bit is intend to remove AHB burst start address alignment limitation.

enumeratedValue.name: READADDROPT_0
enumeratedValue.description: There is AHB read burst start address alignment limitation when flash is accessed in parallel mode or flash is wordaddressable.

enumeratedValue.name: READADDROPT_1
enumeratedValue.description: There is no AHB read burst start address alignment limitation. FlexSPI will fetch more data than AHB burst required to meet the alignment requirement.

field.name: WMOPT1
field.description: Write mask option bit 1. This option bit could be used to remove AHB write burst start address alignment limitation.

enumeratedValue.name: WMOPT1_0
enumeratedValue.description: DQS pin will be used as Write Mask when writing to external device. There is no limitation on AHB write burst start address alignment when flash is accessed in individual mode.

enumeratedValue.name: WMOPT1_1
enumeratedValue.description: DQS pin will not be used as Write Mask when writing to external device. There is limitation on AHB write burst start address alignment when flash is accessed in individual mode.

field.name: WMENA
field.description: Write mask enable bit for flash device on port A. When write mask function is needed for memory device on port A, this bit must be set.

enumeratedValue.name: WMENA_0
enumeratedValue.description: Write mask is disabled, DQS(RWDS) pin will be un-driven when writing to external device.

enumeratedValue.name: WMENA_1
enumeratedValue.description: Write mask is enabled, DQS(RWDS) pin will be driven by FlexSPI as write mask output when writing to external device.

field.name: WMENB
field.description: Write mask enable bit for flash device on port B. When write mask function is needed for memory device on port B, this bit must be set.

enumeratedValue.name: WMENB_0
enumeratedValue.description: Write mask is disabled, DQS(RWDS) pin will be un-driven when writing to external device.

enumeratedValue.name: WMENB_1
enumeratedValue.description: Write mask is enabled, DQS(RWDS) pin will be driven by FlexSPI as write mask output when writing to external device.

field.name: DLLRESET
field.description: Software could force a reset on DLL by setting this field to 0x1. This will cause the DLL to lose lock and re-calibrate to detect an ref_clock half period phase shift. The reset action is edge triggered, so software need to clear this bit after set this bit (no delay limitation).

field.name: OVRDEN

field.name: SEQIDLE
field.description: This status bit indicates the state machine in SEQ_CTL is idle and there is command sequence executing on FlexSPI interface.

field.name: ARBIDLE
field.description: This status bit indicates the state machine in ARB_CTL is busy and there is command sequence granted by arbitrator and not finished yet on FlexSPI interface. When ARB_CTL state (ARBIDLE=0x1) is idle, there will be no transaction on FlexSPI interface also (SEQIDLE=0x1). So this bit should be polled to wait for FlexSPI controller become idle instead of SEQIDLE.

field.name: ARBCMDSRC
field.description: This status field indicates the trigger source of current command sequence granted by arbitrator. This field value is meaningless when ARB_CTL is not busy (STS0[ARBIDLE]=0x1).

enumeratedValue.name: ARBCMDSRC_0
enumeratedValue.description: Triggered by AHB read command (triggered by AHB read).

enumeratedValue.name: ARBCMDSRC_1
enumeratedValue.description: Triggered by AHB write command (triggered by AHB Write).

enumeratedValue.name: ARBCMDSRC_2
enumeratedValue.description: Triggered by IP command (triggered by setting register bit IPCMD.TRG).

enumeratedValue.description: The EtherType 0x88a8 will be considered in addition to 0x8100 (C-VLAN) to identify a VLAN frame in receive. When a VLAN frame is identified, the two bytes following the VLAN type are extracted and used by the classification match comparators, RCMRn.

enumeratedValue.name: VLANUSE2ND_1
enumeratedValue.description: When a double-tagged frame is detected, the data of the second tag is extracted for further processing. A double-tagged frame is defined as: The first tag can be a C-VLAN or a S-VLAN (if SVLAN_ENA = 1) The second tag must be a C-VLAN

field.name: SHIFT16
field.description: TX FIFO Shift-16

enumeratedValue.name: SHIFT16_1
enumeratedValue.description: Indicates to the transmit data FIFO that the written frames contain two additional octets before the frame data. This means the actual frame begins at bit 16 of the first word written into the FIFO. This function allows putting the frame payload on a 32-bit boundary in memory, as the 14-byte Ethernet header is extended to a 16-byte header.

field.name: IPCHK
field.description: Enables insertion of IP header checksum.

enumeratedValue.name: IPCHK_1
enumeratedValue.description: If an IP frame is transmitted, the checksum is inserted automatically. The IP header checksum field must be cleared. If a non-IP frame is transmitted the frame is not modified.

field.name: PROCHK
field.description: Enables insertion of protocol checksum.

enumeratedValue.name: PROCHK_1
enumeratedValue.description: If an IP frame with a known protocol is transmitted, the checksum is inserted automatically into the frame. The checksum field must be cleared. The other frames are not modified.

field.name: PADREM
field.description: Enable Padding Removal For Short IP Frames

enumeratedValue.name: PADREM_1
enumeratedValue.description: Any bytes following the IP payload section of the frame are removed from the frame.

field.name: IPDIS
field.description: Enable Discard Of Frames With Wrong IPv4 Header Checksum

enumeratedValue.name: IPDIS_0
enumeratedValue.description: Frames with wrong IPv4 header checksum are not discarded.

enumeratedValue.name: IPDIS_1
enumeratedValue.description: If an IPv4 frame is received with a mismatching header checksum, the frame is discarded. IPv6 has no header checksum and is not affected by this setting. Discarding is only available when the RX FIFO operates in store and forward mode (RSFL cleared).

field.name: PRODIS
field.description: Enable Discard Of Frames With Wrong Protocol Checksum

enumeratedValue.name: PRODIS_0
enumeratedValue.description: Frames with wrong checksum are not discarded.

enumeratedValue.name: PRODIS_1
enumeratedValue.description: If a TCP/IP, UDP/IP, or ICMP/IP frame is received that has a wrong TCP, UDP, or ICMP checksum, the frame is discarded. Discarding is only available when the RX FIFO operates in store and forward mode (RSFL cleared).

field.name: LINEDIS
field.description: Enable Discard Of Frames With MAC Layer Errors

enumeratedValue.name: LINEDIS_0
enumeratedValue.description: Frames with errors are not discarded.

enumeratedValue.name: LINEDIS_1
enumeratedValue.description: Any frame received with a CRC, length, or PHY error is automatically discarded and not forwarded to the user application interface.

field.name: SHIFT16
field.description: RX FIFO Shift-16

enumeratedValue.name: SHIFT16_1
enumeratedValue.description: Instructs the MAC to write two additional bytes in front of each frame received into the RX FIFO.

enumeratedValue.name: CALC_NOIPG_1

This addition can be suppressed, meaning short frames will become more bandwidth than large frames due to the relation of data to IPG overhead).

field.name: EN
field.description: Enable Timer

enumeratedValue.name: EN_0
enumeratedValue.description: The timer stops at the current value.

field.name: OFFEN
field.description: Enable One-Shot Offset Event

enumeratedValue.name: OFFEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: The timer can be reset to zero when the given offset time is reached (offset event). The field is cleared when the offset event is reached, so no further event occurs until the field is set again. The timer offset value must be set before setting this field.

field.name: OFFRST
field.description: Reset Timer On Offset Event

enumeratedValue.name: OFFRST_0
enumeratedValue.description: The timer is not affected and no action occurs, besides clearing OFFEN, when the offset is reached.

enumeratedValue.name: OFFRST_1
enumeratedValue.description: If OFFEN is set, the timer resets to zero when the offset setting is reached. The offset event does not cause a timer interrupt.

field.name: PEREN
field.description: Enable Periodical Event

enumeratedValue.name: PEREN_1
enumeratedValue.description: A period event interrupt can be generated (EIR[TS_TIMER]) and the event signal output is asserted when the timer wraps around according to the periodic setting ATPER. The timer period value must be set before setting this bit. Not all devices contain the event signal output. See the chip configuration details.

field.name: PINPER
field.description: Enables event signal output assertion on period event

field.name: RESTART
field.description: Reset Timer

field.name: CAPTURE

enumeratedValue.name: CAPTURE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The current time is captured and can be read from the ATVR register.

field.name: SLAVE
field.description: Enable Timer Slave Mode

enumeratedValue.name: SLAVE_0
enumeratedValue.description: The timer is active and all configuration fields in this register are relevant.

enumeratedValue.name: SLAVE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The internal timer is disabled and the externally provided timer value is used. All other fields, except CAPTURE, in this register have no effect. CAPTURE can still be used to capture the current timer value.

enumeratedValue.name: TMODE_6

enumeratedValue.name: TMODE_7
enumeratedValue.description: Timer Channel is configured for Output Compare - set output on compare.

enumeratedValue.name: TMODE_9
enumeratedValue.description: Timer Channel is configured for Output Compare - set output on compare, clear output on overflow.

enumeratedValue.name: TMODE_10
enumeratedValue.description: Timer Channel is configured for Output Compare - clear output on compare, set output on overflow.

enumeratedValue.name: BUSY_DISABLED

enumeratedValue.description: Enable the use of the busy signal from the LCD controller.

field.name: VSYNC_EDGE_IRQ
field.description: This bit is set to indicate that an interrupt is requested by the LCDIF block

field.name: CUR_FRAME_DONE_IRQ
field.description: This bit is set to indicate that an interrupt is requested by the LCDIF block

field.name: UNDERFLOW_IRQ
field.description: This bit is set to indicate that an interrupt is requested by the LCDIF block

field.name: OVERFLOW_IRQ
field.description: This bit is set to indicate that an interrupt is requested by the LCDIF block

field.name: VSYNC_EDGE_IRQ_EN
field.description: This bit is set to enable an interrupt every time the hardware encounters the leading VSYNC edge in the VSYNC and DOTCLK modes, or the beginning of every field in DVI mode

field.name: CUR_FRAME_DONE_IRQ_EN
field.description: This bit is set to 1 enable an interrupt every time the hardware enters in the vertical blanking state

field.name: UNDERFLOW_IRQ_EN
field.description: This bit is set to enable an underflow interrupt in the TXFIFO in the write mode.

field.name: OVERFLOW_IRQ_EN
field.description: This bit is set to enable an overflow interrupt in the TXFIFO in the write mode.

field.name: BYTE_PACKING_FORMAT
field.description: This bitfield is used to show which data bytes in a 32-bit word are valid

field.name: IRQ_ON_ALTERNATE_FIELDS
field.description: If this bit is set, the LCDIF block will assert the cur_frame_done interrupt only on alternate fields, otherwise it will issue the interrupt on both odd and even field

field.name: FIFO_CLEAR
field.description: Set this bit to clear all the data in the latency FIFO (LFIFO), TXFIFO and the RXFIFO.

field.name: START_INTERLACE_FROM_SECOND_FIELD
field.description: The default is to grab the odd lines first and then the even lines

field.name: INTERLACE_FIELDS
field.description: Set this bit if it is required that the LCDIF block fetches odd lines in one field and even lines in the other field

field.name: RECOVER_ON_UNDERFLOW
field.description: Set this bit to enable the LCDIF block to recover in the next field/frame if there was an underflow in the current field/frame

field.name: BM_ERROR_IRQ
field.description: This bit is set to indicate that an interrupt is requested by the LCDIF block

field.name: BM_ERROR_IRQ_EN
field.description: This bit is set to enable bus master error interrupt in the LCDIF master mode.

field.name: COMBINE_MPU_WR_STRB
field.description: If this bit is not set, the write strobe will be driven on LCD_WR_RWn pin in the 8080 mode and on the LCD_RD_E pin in the 6800 mode

field.description: Reset bit for the external LCD controller

field.description: This bit is used to select between the 8080 and 6800 series of microprocessor modes

field.name: FIFO_CLEAR
field.description: Set this bit to clear all the data in the latency FIFO (LFIFO), TXFIFO and the RXFIFO.

field.name: START_INTERLACE_FROM_SECOND_FIELD
field.description: The default is to grab the odd lines first and then the even lines

field.name: INTERLACE_FIELDS
field.description: Set this bit if it is required that the LCDIF block fetches odd lines in one field and even lines in the other field

field.name: RECOVER_ON_UNDERFLOW
field.description: Set this bit to enable the LCDIF block to recover in the next field/frame if there was an underflow in the current field/frame

field.name: BM_ERROR_IRQ
field.description: This bit is set to indicate that an interrupt is requested by the LCDIF block

field.name: BM_ERROR_IRQ_EN
field.description: This bit is set to enable bus master error interrupt in the LCDIF master mode.

field.name: COMBINE_MPU_WR_STRB
field.description: If this bit is not set, the write strobe will be driven on LCD_WR_RWn pin in the 8080 mode and on the LCD_RD_E pin in the 6800 mode

field.name: RESET
field.description: Reset bit for the external LCD controller

field.name: MODE86
field.description: This bit is used to select between the 8080 and 6800 series of microprocessor modes

enumeratedValue.name: 8080_MODE
enumeratedValue.description: Pins LCD_WR_RWn and LCD_RD_E function as active low WR and active low RD signals respectively.

enumeratedValue.name: 6800_MODE
enumeratedValue.description: Pins LCD_WR_RWn and LCD_RD_E function as Read/Write and active high Enable signals respectively.

field.name: BUSY_ENABLE
field.description: This bit enables the use of the interface's busy signal input

enumeratedValue.name: BUSY_DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: The busy signal from the LCD controller will be ignored.

enumeratedValue.name: BUSY_ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enable the use of the busy signal from the LCD controller.

register.name: VDCTRL0

field.name: VSYNC_PULSE_WIDTH
field.description: Number of units for which VSYNC signal is active

field.name: HALF_LINE_MODE
field.description: When this bit is 0, the first field (VSYNC period) will end in half a horizontal line and the second field will begin with half a horizontal line

field.name: HALF_LINE
field.description: Setting this bit to 1 will make the total VSYNC period equal to the VSYNC_PERIOD field plus half the HORIZONTAL_PERIOD field (i

field.name: VSYNC_PULSE_WIDTH_UNIT
field.description: Default 0 for counting VSYNC_PULSE_WIDTH in terms of DISPLAY CLOCK (pix_clk) cycles

field.name: VSYNC_PERIOD_UNIT
field.description: Default 0 for counting VSYNC_PERIOD in terms of DISPLAY CLOCK (pix_clk) cycles

field.name: ENABLE_POL
field.description: Default 0 active low during valid data transfer on each horizontal line.

field.name: DOTCLK_POL
field.description: Default is data launched at negative edge of DOTCLK and captured at positive edge

field.name: HSYNC_POL
field.description: Default 0 active low during HSYNC_PULSE_WIDTH time and will be high during the rest of the HSYNC period

field.name: VSYNC_POL
field.description: Default 0 active low during VSYNC_PULSE_WIDTH time and will be high during the rest of the VSYNC period

field.name: ENABLE_PRESENT
field.description: Setting this bit to 1 will make the hardware generate the ENABLE signal in the DOTCLK mode, thereby making it the true RGB interface along with the remaining three signals VSYNC, HSYNC and DOTCLK

field.name: VSYNC_OEB
field.description: 0 means the VSYNC signal is an output, 1 means it is an input

enumeratedValue.name: VSYNC_OUTPUT
enumeratedValue.description: The VSYNC pin is in the output mode and the VSYNC signal has to be generated by the LCDIF block.

enumeratedValue.name: VSYNC_INPUT
enumeratedValue.description: The VSYNC pin is in the input mode and the LCD controller sends the VSYNC signal to the block.

field.name: VSYNC_PERIOD
field.description: Total number of units between two positive or two negative edges of the VSYNC signal

register.name: VDCTRL2
register.description: LCDIF VSYNC Mode and Dotclk Mode Control Register2

field.name: HSYNC_PERIOD
field.description: Total number of DISPLAY CLOCK (pix_clk) cycles between two positive or two negative edges of the HSYNC signal

field.name: HSYNC_PULSE_WIDTH
field.description: Number of DISPLAY CLOCK (pix_clk) cycles for which HSYNC signal is active.

register.name: VDCTRL3
register.description: LCDIF VSYNC Mode and Dotclk Mode Control Register3

field.name: VERTICAL_WAIT_CNT
field.description: In the VSYNC interface mode, wait for this number of DISPLAY CLOCK (pix_clk) cycles from the falling VSYNC edge (or rising if VSYNC_POL is 1) before starting LCD transactions and is applicable only if WAIT_FOR_VSYNC_EDGE is set

field.name: HORIZONTAL_WAIT_CNT
field.description: In the DOTCLK mode, wait for this number of clocks from falling edge (or rising if HSYNC_POL is 1) of HSYNC signal to account for horizontal back porch plus the number of DOTCLKs before the moving picture information begins

field.name: VSYNC_ONLY
field.description: This bit must be set to 1 in the VSYNC mode of operation, and 0 in the DOTCLK mode of operation.

field.name: MUX_SYNC_SIGNALS
field.description: When this bit is set, the LCDIF block will internally mux HSYNC with LCD_D14, DOTCLK with LCD_D13 and ENABLE with LCD_D12, otherwise these signals will go out on separate pins

register.name: VDCTRL4
register.description: LCDIF VSYNC Mode and Dotclk Mode Control Register4

field.name: DOTCLK_H_VALID_DATA_CNT
field.description: Total number of DISPLAY CLOCK (pix_clk) cycles on each horizontal line that carry valid data in DOTCLK mode

field.name: SYNC_SIGNALS_ON
field.description: Set this field to 1 if the LCD controller requires that the VSYNC or VSYNC/HSYNC/DOTCLK control signals should be active at least one frame before the data transfers actually start and remain active at least one frame after the data transfers end

field.name: DOTCLK_DLY_SEL
field.description: This bitfield selects the amount of time by which the DOTCLK signal should be delayed before coming out of the LCD_DOTCK pin

field.name: H_BLANKING_CNT
field.description: Number of blanking samples to be inserted between EAV and SAV during horizontal blanking interval.

field.name: H_ACTIVE_CNT
field.description: Number of active video samples to be transmitted

field.description: Vertical line number from which Field 2 begins.

field.name: F1_END_LINE
field.description: Vertical line number at which Field1 ends.

field.name: F1_START_LINE
field.description: Vertical line number from which Field 1 begins.

field.name: V1_BLANK_END_LINE
field.description: Vertical line number in the beginning part of Field2 where first Vertical Blanking interval ends.

field.name: V1_BLANK_START_LINE
field.description: Vertical line number towards the end of Field1 where first Vertical Blanking interval starts.

field.name: F2_END_LINE
field.description: Vertical line number at which Field 2 ends.

field.name: V_LINES_CNT
field.description: Total number of vertical lines per frame (generally 525 or 625)

field.name: V2_BLANK_END_LINE

field.name: V2_BLANK_START_LINE

field.name: Y_FILL_VALUE

register.name: CSC_COEFF0
register.description: RGB to YCbCr 4:2:2 CSC Coefficient0 Register

field.name: CSC_SUBSAMPLE_FILTER
field.description: This register describes the filtering and subsampling scheme to be performed on the chroma components in order to convert from YCbCr 4:4:4 to YCbCr 4:2:2 space

enumeratedValue.name: SAMPLE_AND_HOLD
enumeratedValue.description: No filtering, simply keep every chroma value for samples numbered 2n and discard chroma values associated with all samples numbered 2n+1.

enumeratedValue.name: INTERSTITIAL
enumeratedValue.description: Chroma samples numbered 2n and 2n+1 are averaged (weights 1/2, 1/2) and that chroma value replaces the two chroma values at 2n and 2n+1. This chroma now exists horizontally halfway between the two luma samples.

enumeratedValue.name: COSITED
enumeratedValue.description: Chroma samples numbered 2n-1, 2n, and 2n+1 are averaged (weights 1/4, 1/2, 1/4) and that chroma value exists at the same site as the luma sample numbered 2n and the chroma samples at 2n+1 are discarded.

field.name: TXFIFO_EMPTY
field.description: Read only view of the signals that indicates LCD TXFIFO is empty.

field.name: TXFIFO_FULL
field.description: Read only view of the signals that indicates LCD TXFIFO is full.

field.name: LFIFO_EMPTY
field.description: Read only view of the signals that indicates LCD LFIFO is empty.

field.name: LFIFO_FULL
field.description: Read only view of the signals that indicates LCD LFIFO is full.

field.name: PRESENT
field.description: 0: LCDIF not present on this product 1: LCDIF is present.

field.name: PANIC
field.description: This value should be set to a value of pixels from 0 to 511

field.name: FASTCLOCK
field.description: This value should be set to a value of pixels, from 0 to 511

field.name: AS_ENABLE
field.description: When this bit is set by software, the LCDIF will start fetching AS buffer data in bus master mode and combine it with another buffer

field.name: ALPHA_CTRL
field.description: Determines how the alpha value is constructed for this alpha surface

field.name: ENABLE_COLORKEY
field.description: Indicates that colorkey functionality is enabled for this alpha surface

field.name: FORMAT
field.description: Indicates the input buffer format for AS

field.name: ALPHA
field.description: Alpha modifier used when the ALPHA_MULTIPLY or ALPHA_OVERRIDE values are programmed in REG_AS_CTRL[ALPHA_CTRL]

field.name: ROP
field.description: Indicates a raster operation to perform when enabled

field.name: ALPHA_INVERT
field.description: Setting this bit to logic 0 will not alter the alpha value

field.name: INPUT_DATA_SWIZZLE
field.description: This field specifies how to swap the bytes either in the HW_LCDIF_DATA register or those fetched by the AXI master part of LCDIF

field.name: PS_DISABLE
field.description: When this bit is set by software, the LCDIF will disable PS buffer data.

field.name: RVDS1
field.description: Reserved, always set to zero.

field.name: CSI_SYNC_ON_IRQ
field.description: this bit is set by software to decide which vsync generate mode

field.name: CSI_SYNC_ON_IRQ_EN
field.description: This bit is set to enable an interrupt when LCDIF lock with CSI vsync input.

field.name: CSI_VSYNC_MODE
field.description: this bit is set by software to decide which vsync generate mode

field.name: CSI_VSYNC_POL
field.description: Default 0 active low during VSYNC_PULSE_WIDTH time and will be high during the rest of the VSYNC period

field.name: CSI_VSYNC_ENABLE
field.description: When this bit is set by software, the LCDIF work as sync mode with CSI input.

field.name: ADDR
field.description: Address pointer for the alpha surface 0 buffer.

register.name: AS_NEXT_BUF
register.description: When the LCDIF is behaving as a master, this address points to the address of the next frame of data that will be sent out via the LCDIF. It is upto the software to make sure that this register is programmed before the end of the current frame, otherwise it might result in old data going out the LCDIF. This address must always be double-word aligned.

field.name: ADDR
field.description: Address of the next frame that will be transmitted by LCDIF.

field.name: PIXEL
field.description: Low range of RGB color key applied to AS buffer

field.name: RSVD1
field.description: Reserved, always set to zero.

field.name: PIXEL
field.description: High range of RGB color key applied to AS buffer

field.name: RSVD1
field.description: Reserved, always set to zero.

register.name: SYNC_DELAY
register.description: LCD working insync mode with CSI for VSYNC delay

field.name: H_COUNT_DELAY
field.description: LCDIF VSYNC delayed counter for CSI_VSYNC.

field.name: V_COUNT_DELAY
field.description: LCDIF VSYNC delayed counter for CSI_VSYNC.

register.name: _CTRL1
register.description: The USB_n_PHY_CTRL1 register controls the integration specific features of the USB PHY modules. These features are not directly related to basic USB functionality, but control special features, interfacing on the USB ports, as well as power control and wake-up functionality.

field.name: OVER_CUR_DIS
field.description: Disable Overcurrent Detection

field.name: OVER_CUR_POL
field.description: Polarity of Overcurrent The polarity of OTG1 port overcurrent event

enumeratedValue.name: OVER_CUR_POL_0
enumeratedValue.description: High active (high on this signal represents an overcurrent condition)

enumeratedValue.name: OVER_CUR_POL_1
enumeratedValue.description: Low active (low on this signal represents an overcurrent condition)

field.name: PWR_POL
field.description: Power Polarity This bit should be set according to PMIC Power Pin polarity.

enumeratedValue.name: PWR_POL_0
enumeratedValue.description: PMIC Power Pin is Low active.

enumeratedValue.name: PWR_POL_1
enumeratedValue.description: PMIC Power Pin is High active.

field.name: WIE
field.description: Wake-up Interrupt Enable This bit enables or disables the OTG1 wake-up interrupt

field.name: WKUP_SW_EN
field.description: Software Wake-up Enable

field.name: WKUP_SW
field.description: Software Wake-up

field.name: WKUP_ID_EN
field.description: Wake-up on ID change enable

field.name: WKUP_VBUS_EN
field.description: Wake-up on VBUS change enable

field.name: WKUP_DPDM_EN
field.description: Wake-up on DPDM change enable

enumeratedValue.name: WKUP_DPDM_EN_0
enumeratedValue.description: DPDM changes wake-up to be disabled only when VBUS is 0.

enumeratedValue.name: WKUP_DPDM_EN_1
enumeratedValue.description: (Default) DPDM changes wake-up to be enabled, it is for device only.

field.name: WIR
field.description: Wake-up Interrupt Request This bit indicates that a wake-up interrupt request is received on the OTG1 port

register.name: _CTRL2
register.description: The USB_OTGx_PHY_CTRL2 register allows observation of the UTMI Clock Valid status along with control of selected inputs to the USB OTG PHY transceiver. Some of these input signals may be used for USB out-of-band signaling. Customers should use caution when overriding any UTMI signals since that will interfere with normal USB data communication.

field.name: VBUS_SOURCE_SEL
field.description: VBUS source select used to detect a VBUS wakeup event

field.name: AUTURESUME_EN
field.description: Auto Resume Enable

field.name: LOWSPEED_EN
field.description: Set if AUTURESUME_EN is set and works on low speed.

field.name: TERMSEL_OVERRIDE
field.description: Controls the state of the UTMI TermSelect signal to the USB OTG PHY if the value of USBNC_x_CTRL2[TERMSEL_OVERRIDEEN] is set to 1'b1

field.name: TERMSEL_OVERRIDEEN
field.description: Enables override of control of the UTMI TermSelect signal to the USB OTG PHY instead of using the state normally set by the USB controller

enumeratedValue.name: TERMSEL_OVERRIDEEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: The state of the UTMI TermSelect signal to the USB PHY is set by the USB controller.

enumeratedValue.name: TERMSEL_OVERRIDEEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: The state of the UTMI TermSelect signal to the USB PHY is set by the value in the USBNC_x_CTRL2[TERMSEL_OVERRIDE] bit field.

field.name: OPMODE_OVERRIDE
field.description: Controls the state of the UTMI XcvrSelect signals to the USB OTG PHY if the value of USBNC_x_CTRL2[OPMODE_OVERRIDEEN] is set to 1'b1

field.name: OPMODE_OVERRIDEEN
field.description: Enables override of control of the UTMI OpMode signals to the USB OTG PHY instead of using the state normally set by the USB controller

enumeratedValue.name: OPMODE_OVERRIDEEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: The state of the UTMI OpMode signals to the USB PHY is set by the USB controller.

enumeratedValue.name: OPMODE_OVERRIDEEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: The state of the UTMI OpMode signals to the USB PHY is set by the values in the USBNC_x_CTRL2[OPMODE_OVERRIDE] bit field.

field.name: XCVRSEL_OVERRIDE
field.description: Controls the state of the UTMI XcvrSelect signals to the USB OTG PHY if the value of USBNC_x_CTRL2[XCVRSEL_OVERRIDEEN] is set to 1'b1

field.name: XCVRSEL_OVERRIDEEN
field.description: Enables override of control of the UTMI XcvrSelect signals to the USB OTG PHY instead of using the state normally set by the USB controller

enumeratedValue.name: XCVRSEL_OVERRIDEEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: The state of the UTMI XcvrSelect signals to the USB PHY is set by the USB controller.

enumeratedValue.name: XCVRSEL_OVERRIDEEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: The state of the UTMI XcvrSelect signals to the USB PHY is set by the values in the USBNC_x_CTRL2[XCVRSEL_OVERRIDE] bit field.

field.name: DPPULLDOWN_OVERRIDE
field.description: Controls state of DP pulldown resistor if USBNC_n_CTRL2[DPPULLDOWN_OVERRIDEEN] is set to 1'b1.

field.name: DPPULLDOWN_OVERRIDEEN
field.description: Enables override of control of the DP pulldown resistor instead of using the state set by the USB controller

enumeratedValue.name: DPPULLDOWN_OVERRIDEEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: USB controller enables/disables the DP pulldown resistor in the USB PHY.

enumeratedValue.name: DPPULLDOWN_OVERRIDEEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Use the value set by the USBNC_n_CTRL2[DPPULLDOWN_OVERRIDE] bit field to enable/disable the DP pulldown resistor in the USB PHY.

field.name: DMPULLDOWN_OVERRIDE
field.description: Controls state of DM pulldown resistor if USBNC_n_CTRL2[DMPULLDOWN_OVERRIDEEN] is set to 1'b1.

field.name: DMPULLDOWN_OVERRIDEEN
field.description: Enables override of control of the DM pulldown resistor instead of the state set by the USB controller

enumeratedValue.name: DMPULLDOWN_OVERRIDEEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: USB controller enables/disables the DM pulldown resistor in the USB PHY.

enumeratedValue.name: DMPULLDOWN_OVERRIDEEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Use the value set by the USBNC_n_CTRL2[DMPULLDOWN_OVERRIDE] bit field to enable/disable the DM pulldown resistor in the USB PHY.

field.name: DIG_ID_SEL
field.description: Selects whether the USB OTG ID pin function is connected to the PHY's USB_OTG*_ID pin or a GPIO pin

enumeratedValue.name: DIG_ID_SEL_0
enumeratedValue.description: Use the USB_OTG*_ID pin for the USB OTG ID pin detection function(default)

enumeratedValue.name: DIG_ID_SEL_1
enumeratedValue.description: Use the pin configured by the IOMUXC_USB_OTG*_ID_SELECT_INPUT register for the USB OTG ID pin detection function

field.name: UTMI_CLK_VLD
field.description: Indicate whether PHY clock is valid. Write 1 to clear

enumeratedValue.name: UTMI_CLK_VLD_0
enumeratedValue.description: UTMI clock to USB PHY is not toggling (Default)

enumeratedValue.name: UTMI_CLK_VLD_1
enumeratedValue.description: UTMI clock to USB PHY has toggled several times

field.name: COMMONONN
field.description: Common Block Power-Down Control

enumeratedValue.name: COMMONONN_0
enumeratedValue.description: In Suspend or Sleep modes, the Bias and PLL blocks remain powered

enumeratedValue.name: COMMONONN_1
enumeratedValue.description: In Suspend or Sleep modes, the Bias and PLL blocks are powered down

field.name: FSEL
field.description: Reference Clock Frequency Select

enumeratedValue.name: FSEL_5
enumeratedValue.description: 24 MHz (only valid setting for this SOC)

field.name: COMPDISTUNE0
field.description: Disconnect Threshold Adjustment

field.name: SQRXTUNE0
field.description: Squelch Threshold Adjustment

field.name: OTGTUNE0
field.description: VBUS Valid Threshold Adjustment

field.name: TXHSXVTUNE0
field.description: Transmitter High-Speed Crossover Adjustment

field.name: TXFSLSTUNE0
field.description: FS/LS Source Impedance Adjustment

field.name: TXVREFTUNE0
field.description: HS DC Voltage Level Adjustment

field.name: TXRISETUNE0
field.description: HS Transmitter Rise/Fall Time Adjustment

field.name: TXRESTUNE0
field.description: USB Source Impedance Adjustment

enumeratedValue.name: TXRESTUNE0_0
enumeratedValue.description: Source impedance is increased by approximately 1.5 ohm

enumeratedValue.name: TXRESTUNE0_2
enumeratedValue.description: Source impedance is decreased by approximately 2 ohm

enumeratedValue.name: TXRESTUNE0_3
enumeratedValue.description: Source impedance is decreased by approximately 4 ohm

field.name: TXPREEMPAMPTUNE0
field.description: HS Treansmitter Pre-Emphasis Current Control

enumeratedValue.name: TXPREEMPAMPTUNE0_1
enumeratedValue.description: HS Transmitter pre-emphasis circuit sources 1X pre-emphasis current (design default)

enumeratedValue.name: TXPREEMPAMPTUNE0_2
enumeratedValue.description: HS Transmitter pre-emphasis circuit sources 2X pre-emphasis current

enumeratedValue.name: TXPREEMPAMPTUNE0_3
enumeratedValue.description: HS Transmitter pre-emphasis circuit sources 3X pre-emphasis current

field.name: TXPREEMPPULSETUNE0
field.description: HS Transmitter Pre-Emphasis Duration Control

field.name: CHRGDET_Megamix
field.description: USB_OTG1_CHD_B output control

enumeratedValue.name: CHRGDET_Megamix_0
enumeratedValue.description: The external state of USB_OTG1_CHD_B is only controlled by the state of the CHRGDET signal

enumeratedValue.name: CHRGDET_Megamix_1
enumeratedValue.description: The external state of USB_OTG1_CHD_B is forced low

field.name: CHRGSEL
field.description: Battery Charging Source Select

enumeratedValue.name: CHRGSEL_0
enumeratedValue.description: VDP_SRC is connected to USB_OTG*_DP and IDM_SINK is connected to USB_OTG*_DN. Used for Primary Detection.

enumeratedValue.name: CHRGSEL_1
enumeratedValue.description: VDM_SRC is connected to USB_OTG*_DN and IDP_SINK is connected to USB_OTG*_DP. Used for Secondary Detection.

field.name: VDATDETENB0
field.description: Battery Charging Detection Comparator Enable

enumeratedValue.name: VDATDETENB0_0
enumeratedValue.description: Battery Charging detection comparator connected to USB_OTG*_D* pin is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: VDATDETENB0_1
enumeratedValue.description: Battery Charging detection comparator connected to USB_OTG*_D* pin is enabled

field.name: VDATSRCENB0
field.description: Battery Charging Source Select

field.name: DCDENB
field.description: Data Contact Detection Enable

enumeratedValue.name: DCDENB_0
enumeratedValue.description: IDP_SRC current and RDM_DWN pull-down resistance are disabled

enumeratedValue.name: DCDENB_1
enumeratedValue.description: IDP_SRC current and RDM_DWN pull-down resistance are enabled

field.name: ACAENB0
field.description: ACA USB_OTG*_ID Pin Resistance Detection Enable

enumeratedValue.name: ACAENB0_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disables detection of resistance on the USB_OTG*_ID pin

enumeratedValue.name: ACAENB0_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enables detection of resistance on the USB_OTG*_ID pin

field.name: SLEEPM0
field.description: Sleep Mode Assertion

field.name: LOOPBACKENB0
field.description: Loopback Test Enable

enumeratedValue.name: LOOPBACKENB0_0
enumeratedValue.description: During data transmission, the receive logic is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: LOOPBACKENB0_1
enumeratedValue.description: During data transmission, the receive logic is enabled

field.name: TXBITSTUFFEN0
field.description: Low-Byte Transmit Bit-Stuffing Enable

field.name: TXBITSTUFFENH0
field.description: High-Byte Transmit Bit-Stuffing Enable

field.name: OTGDISABLE0
field.description: OTG Block Disable

enumeratedValue.name: OTGDISABLE0_0
enumeratedValue.description: The OTG block is powered up

enumeratedValue.name: OTGDISABLE0_1
enumeratedValue.description: The OTG block is powered down

field.name: ADPCHRG0
field.description: VBUS Input ADP Charge Enable

field.name: ADPDISCHRG0
field.description: VBUS Input ADP Discharge Enable

field.name: ADPPRBENB0
field.description: ADP Probe Enable

field.name: VBUSVLDEXTSEL0
field.description: External VBUS Valid Select

enumeratedValue.name: VBUSVLDEXTSEL0_0
enumeratedValue.description: The USB OTG PHY internal Session Valid comparator is used to enable the pull-up resistor on the USB_OTG*_DP pin

enumeratedValue.name: VBUSVLDEXTSEL0_1
enumeratedValue.description: The VBUSVLDEXT signal is used to enable the pull-up resistor on the USB_OTG*_DP pin

field.name: VBUSVLDEXT
field.description: External VBUS Valid Indicator

enumeratedValue.name: VBUSVLDEXT_0
enumeratedValue.description: The VBUS signal sensed outside the USB OTG PHY is not valid, and the pull-up resistor on USB_OTG*_DP is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: VBUSVLDEXT_1
enumeratedValue.description: The VBUS signal sensed outside the USB OTG PHY is valid, and the pull-up resistor on USB_OTG*_DP is enabled

field.name: DRVVBUS0

enumeratedValue.name: DRVVBUS0_0
enumeratedValue.description: The VBUS Valid comparator is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: DRVVBUS0_1

field.name: LINE_STATE
field.description: Line State Indicator outputs from USB OTG PHY

enumeratedValue.name: LINE_STATE_1
enumeratedValue.description: J state for high-speed and full-speed USB traffic; K state for low-speed USB traffic (DP high, DN low)

enumeratedValue.name: LINE_STATE_2
enumeratedValue.description: K state for high-speed and full-speed USB traffic; J state for low-speed USB traffic (DP low, DN high)

field.name: SESS_VLD

enumeratedValue.name: SESS_VLD_0
enumeratedValue.description: The voltage on USB_OTG*_VBUS is below the OTG Device Session Valid threshold

enumeratedValue.name: SESS_VLD_1
enumeratedValue.description: The voltage on USB_OTG*_VBUS is above the OTG Device Session Valid threshold

field.name: VBUS_VLD
field.description: VBUS Valid Indicator from USB OTG PHY

enumeratedValue.name: VBUS_VLD_0
enumeratedValue.description: The voltage on USB_OTG*_VBUS is below the VBUS Valid threshold

enumeratedValue.name: VBUS_VLD_1
enumeratedValue.description: The voltage on USB_OTG*_VBUS is above the VBUS Valid threshold

field.name: ID_DIG

field.name: HOST_DISCONNECT
field.description: Peripheral Disconnect Indicator

field.name: RIDC0
field.description: ACA USB_OTG*_ID Pin Resistance Indicator

enumeratedValue.name: RIDC0_0
enumeratedValue.description: ACA OTG_ID pin resistance is >= RID_B (min) and <= RID_GND max

enumeratedValue.name: RIDC0_1
enumeratedValue.description: ACA OTG_ID pin resistance is >= RID_C (min) and <= RID_C max

field.name: RIDB0
field.description: ACA USB_OTG*_ID Pin Resistance Indicator

enumeratedValue.name: RIDB0_0
enumeratedValue.description: ACA OTG_ID pin resistance is >= RID_A (min) and <= RID_C max

enumeratedValue.name: RIDB0_1
enumeratedValue.description: ACA OTG_ID pin resistance is >= RID_B (min) and <= RID_B max

field.name: RIDA0
field.description: ACA USB_OTG*_ID Pin Resistance Indicator

enumeratedValue.name: RIDA0_0
enumeratedValue.description: ACA OTG_ID pin resistance is >= RID_FLOAT (min) and <= RID_B max

enumeratedValue.name: RIDA0_1
enumeratedValue.description: ACA OTG_ID pin resistance is >= RID_A (min) and <= RID_A max

field.name: RIDGND0
field.description: ACA USB_OTG*_ID Pin Resistance Indicator

enumeratedValue.name: RIDGND0_0
enumeratedValue.description: ACA OTG_ID pin resistance is >= RID_C (min)

enumeratedValue.name: RIDGND0_1
enumeratedValue.description: ACA OTG_ID pin resistance is <= RID_GND (max)

field.name: RIDFLOAT0
field.description: ACA USB_OTG*_ID Pin Resistance Indicator

enumeratedValue.name: RIDFLOAT0_0
enumeratedValue.description: ACA OTG_ID pin resistance is <= RID_A (max)

enumeratedValue.name: RIDFLOAT0_1
enumeratedValue.description: ACA OTG_ID pin resistance is >= RID_FLOAT (min)

field.name: CHRGDET

enumeratedValue.name: ADPPRB0_1

field.name: ADPSNS0

register.name: CHANNEL_CTRL
register.description: AHB to APBH Bridge Channel Register

field.name: FREEZE_CHANNEL
field.description: Setting a bit in this field will freeze the DMA channel associated with it

field.name: RESET_CHANNEL
field.description: Setting a bit in this field causes the DMA controller to take the corresponding channel through its reset state

field.name: FREEZE_CHANNEL

field.name: RESET_CHANNEL
field.description: Setting a bit in this field causes the DMA controller to take the corresponding channel through its reset state

field.name: FREEZE_CHANNEL

field.name: RESET_CHANNEL

register.name: CHANNEL_CTRL_TOG

field.name: FREEZE_CHANNEL

field.name: RESET_CHANNEL

register.name: DEVSEL
register.description: AHB to APBH DMA Device Assignment Register

register.name: DMA_BURST_SIZE
register.description: AHB to APBH DMA burst size

field.name: CH0
field.description: DMA burst size for GPMI channel 0. Do not change. GPMI only support burst size 4.

field.name: CH1
field.description: DMA burst size for GPMI channel 1. Do not change. GPMI only support burst size 4.

field.name: CH2
field.description: DMA burst size for GPMI channel 2. Do not change. GPMI only support burst size 4.

field.name: CH3
field.description: DMA burst size for GPMI channel 3. Do not change. GPMI only support burst size 4.

field.name: CH4
field.description: DMA burst size for GPMI channel 4. Do not change. GPMI only support burst size 4.

field.name: CH5
field.description: DMA burst size for GPMI channel 5. Do not change. GPMI only support burst size 4.

field.name: CH6
field.description: DMA burst size for GPMI channel 6. Do not change. GPMI only support burst size 4.

field.name: CH7
field.description: DMA burst size for GPMI channel 7. Do not change. GPMI only support burst size 4.

field.name: CH8
field.description: DMA burst size for SSP.

register.name: DEBUG
register.description: AHB to APBH DMA Debug Register

field.name: GPMI_ONE_FIFO
field.description: Set to 0ne and the 8 GPMI channels will share the DMA FIFO, and when set to zero, the 8 GPMI channels will use its own DMA FIFO

register.name: CH%s_CURCMDAR
register.description: APBH DMA Channel n Current Command Address Register

field.name: CMD_ADDR
field.description: Pointer to command structure currently being processed for channel n.

register.name: CH%s_NXTCMDAR
register.description: APBH DMA Channel n Next Command Address Register

field.name: CMD_ADDR
field.description: Pointer to next command structure for channel n.

register.name: CH%s_CMD
register.description: APBH DMA Channel n Command Register

field.name: COMMAND
field.description: This bitfield indicates the type of current command:

enumeratedValue.name: NO_DMA_XFER
enumeratedValue.description: Perform any requested PIO word transfers but terminate command before any DMA transfer.

enumeratedValue.name: DMA_WRITE
enumeratedValue.description: Perform any requested PIO word transfers and then perform a DMA transfer from the peripheral for the specified number of bytes.

enumeratedValue.name: DMA_READ
enumeratedValue.description: Perform any requested PIO word transfers and then perform a DMA transfer to the peripheral for the specified number of bytes.

enumeratedValue.name: DMA_SENSE
enumeratedValue.description: Perform any requested PIO word transfers and then perform a conditional branch to the next chained device. Follow the NEXCMD_ADDR pointer if the perpheral sense is true. Follow the BUFFER_ADDRESS as a chain pointer if the peripheral sense line is false.

field.name: CHAIN
field.description: A value of one indicates that another command is chained onto the end of the current command structure

field.name: IRQONCMPLT
field.description: A value of one indicates that the channel will cause the interrupt status bit to be set upon completion of the current command, i

field.name: NANDLOCK
field.description: A value of one indicates that the NAND DMA channel will remain "locked" in the arbiter at the expense of other NAND DMA channels

field.name: NANDWAIT4READY
field.description: A value of one indicates that the NAND DMA channel will will wait until the NAND device reports "ready" before executing the command

field.name: SEMAPHORE
field.description: A value of one indicates that the channel will decrement its semaphore at the completion of the current command structure

field.name: WAIT4ENDCMD
field.description: A value of one indicates that the channel will wait for the end of command signal to be sent from the APBH device to the DMA before starting the next DMA command

field.name: HALTONTERMINATE
field.description: A value of one indicates that the channel will immeditately terminate the current descriptor and halt the DMA channel if a terminate signal is set

field.name: CMDWORDS
field.description: This field indicates the number of command words to send to the GPMI0, starting with the base PIO address of the GPMI0 control register and incrementing from there

field.name: XFER_COUNT
field.description: This field indicates the number of bytes to transfer to or from the appropriate PIO register in the GPMI0 device

register.name: CH%s_BAR
register.description: APBH DMA Channel n Buffer Address Register

field.name: ADDRESS
field.description: Address of system memory buffer to be read or written over the AHB bus.

register.name: CH%s_SEMA
register.description: APBH DMA Channel n Semaphore Register

field.name: INCREMENT_SEMA
field.description: The value written to this field is added to the semaphore count in an atomic way such that simultaneous software adds and DMA hardware substracts happening on the same clock are protected

field.name: PHORE
field.description: This read-only field shows the current (instantaneous) value of the semaphore counter.

register.name: CH%s_DEBUG1
register.description: AHB to APBH DMA Channel n Debug Information

field.name: STATEMACHINE
field.description: PIO Display of the DMA Channel n state machine state.

enumeratedValue.name: IDLE
enumeratedValue.description: This is the idle state of the DMA state machine.

enumeratedValue.name: REQ_CMD1
enumeratedValue.description: State in which the DMA is waiting to receive the first word of a command.

enumeratedValue.name: REQ_CMD3
enumeratedValue.description: State in which the DMA is waiting to receive the third word of a command.

enumeratedValue.name: REQ_CMD2
enumeratedValue.description: State in which the DMA is waiting to receive the second word of a command.

enumeratedValue.name: XFER_DECODE
enumeratedValue.description: The state machine processes the descriptor command field in this state and branches accordingly.

enumeratedValue.name: REQ_WAIT
enumeratedValue.description: The state machine waits in this state for the PIO APB cycles to complete.

enumeratedValue.name: REQ_CMD4
enumeratedValue.description: State in which the DMA is waiting to receive the fourth word of a command, or waiting to receive the PIO words when PIO count is greater than 1.

enumeratedValue.name: PIO_REQ
enumeratedValue.description: This state determines whether another PIO cycle needs to occur before starting DMA transfers.

enumeratedValue.name: READ_FLUSH
enumeratedValue.description: During a read transfers, the state machine enters this state waiting for the last bytes to be pushed out on the APB.

enumeratedValue.name: READ_WAIT
enumeratedValue.description: When an AHB read request occurs, the state machine waits in this state for the AHB transfer to complete.

enumeratedValue.name: WRITE
enumeratedValue.description: During DMA Write transfers, the state machine waits in this state until the AHB master arbiter accepts the request from this channel.

enumeratedValue.name: READ_REQ
enumeratedValue.description: During DMA Read transfers, the state machine waits in this state until the AHB master arbiter accepts the request from this channel.

enumeratedValue.name: CHECK_CHAIN
enumeratedValue.description: Upon completion of the DMA transfers, this state checks the value of the Chain bit and branches accordingly.

enumeratedValue.name: XFER_COMPLETE
enumeratedValue.description: The state machine goes to this state after the DMA transfers are complete, and determines what step to take next.

enumeratedValue.name: TERMINATE
enumeratedValue.description: When a terminate signal is set, the state machine enters this state until the current AHB transfer is completed.

enumeratedValue.name: WAIT_END
enumeratedValue.description: When the Wait for Command End bit is set, the state machine enters this state until the DMA device indicates that the command is complete.

enumeratedValue.name: WRITE_WAIT
enumeratedValue.description: During DMA Write transfers, the state machine waits in this state until the AHB master completes the write to the AHB memory space.

enumeratedValue.name: HALT_AFTER_TERM
enumeratedValue.description: If HALTONTERMINATE is set and a terminate signal is set, the state machine enters this state and effectively halts. A channel reset is required to exit this state

enumeratedValue.name: CHECK_WAIT
enumeratedValue.description: If the Chain bit is a 0, the state machine enters this state and effectively halts.

enumeratedValue.name: WAIT_READY
enumeratedValue.description: When the NAND Wait for Ready bit is set, the state machine enters this state until the GPMI device indicates that the external device is ready.

field.name: WR_FIFO_FULL

field.name: WR_FIFO_EMPTY
field.description: This bit reflects the current state of the DMA Channel's Write FIFO Empty signal.

field.name: RD_FIFO_FULL
field.description: This bit reflects the current state of the DMA Channel's Read FIFO Full signal.

field.name: RD_FIFO_EMPTY
field.description: This bit reflects the current state of the DMA Channel's Read FIFO Empty signal.

field.name: NEXTCMDADDRVALID
field.description: This bit reflects the internal bit which indicates whether the channel's next command address is valid

field.name: READY
field.description: This bit is reserved for this DMA Channel and always reads 0.

field.name: END
field.description: This bit reflects the current state of the DMA End Command Signal sent from the APB Device

field.name: KICK
field.description: This bit reflects the current state of the DMA Kick Signal sent to the APB Device

field.name: BURST
field.description: This bit reflects the current state of the DMA Burst Signal from the APB device

field.name: REQ
field.description: This bit reflects the current state of the DMA Request Signal from the APB device

field.description: If set, the read pointer (DFI side) on the read FIFO associated with data bits [3:0] had a non-zero value at least once.

field.name: RxFifoWrLocErr
field.description: If set, the write pointer (DQS side) on the read FIFO associated with data bits [3:0] has a non-zero value at least once.

field.name: RxFifoRdLocUErr
field.description: If set, the read pointer (DFI side) on the read FIFO associated with data bits [7:4] has a non-zero value at least once.

field.name: RxFifoWrLocUErr
field.description: If set, the write pointer (DQS side) on the read FIFO associated with data bits [7:4] has a non-zero value at least once.

register.name: RxFifoCheckErrValues
register.description: Contains the captured values associated with an RxFifo consistency error

field.name: RxFifoRdLocErrValue
field.description: The first error value captured for the read pointer (DFI side) on the read FIFO associated with data bits [3:0];

field.name: RxFifoWrLocErrValue
field.description: The first error value captured for the write pointer (DQS side) on the read FIFO associated with data bits [3:0];

field.name: RxFifoRdLocUErrValue
field.description: The first error value captured for the read pointer (DFI side) on the read FIFO associated with data bits [7:4];

field.name: RxFifoWrLocUErrValue
field.description: The first error value captured for the write pointer (DQS side) on the read FIFO associated with data bits [7:4];

field.name: RxFifoRdLoc
field.description: The Mission mode read pointer of the lower-nibble Rx fifo.

field.name: RxFifoWrLoc
field.description: The Mission mode write pointer of the lower-nibble Rx fifo.

field.name: RxFifoRdLocU
field.description: The Mission mode read pointer of the upper-nibble Rx fifo.

field.name: RxFifoWrLocU
field.description: The Mission mode write pointer of the upper-nibble Rx fifo.

field.name: RxFifoRdPtr
field.description: If CSR RxFifoRdPtrOVr is set, then this CSR selects the rxfifo entry is visible in CSR This 3b field addresses 4b units of the 8x4b (32entry) fifo; that is, rdfifo_nibble_address[2:0]=csrRxFifoRdPtr[2:0] For example, Register RxFifoRdPtr[2:0]=2 will enable reading bit-entries 11.

field.name: RxFifoRdPtrOvr
field.description: 0 : Normal operation - mission mode read pointer is enabled 1 : Override - Control of the rx fifo read pointer is ceded to CSR RxFifoRdPtr.

field.name: RxFifoRdEn
field.description: Pulse set 0-->1-->0 this bit to capture the Fifo Contents.

field.name: RxFifoContentsDQ3210
field.description: A window into the contents of the RxFifo, as controlled by CSR RxFifoVisibility This register reads 4b at a time from lane0.

field.name: RxFifoContentsDQ7654
field.description: A window into the contents of the RxFifo, as controlled by CSR RxFifoVisibility This register reads 4b at a time from lane4.

field.name: RxFifoContentsDBI
field.description: A window into the contents of the RxFifo, as controlled by CSR RxFifoVisibility This register reads 4b at a time from DBI from the four fifo entries addressed by rdfifo_nibble_address[2:0]=RxFifoRdPtr[2:0] Register [ 3: 0] = dbi_ui3,dbi_ui2,dbi_ui1,dbi_ui0 Note that the DBYTE DBI lane is the same as the memory DBI; it is not subject to mapping using csr Dq<7.

field.name: TxPreN
field.description: 4 bit binary trim for the driver pull down slew rate.

field.description: Controls predrivers to adjust timing of turn-on and turn-off of pull-up and pull-down segments.

field.name: DfeCtrl

field.name: DfiRdDestm1
field.description: Maps dfi_rddata_cs_n_p0[1] to dest DfiRdDestm1 timing For example, if 1 dfi_rddata_cs_n[_p01] will use Register RxEn,ClkDlyTg1 timing.

field.name: GlobalVrefInSel
field.description: GlobalVrefInSel[1:0] controls the mode of the PHY VREF DAC and the BP_VREF pin ========================================================== 2'b00 - PHY Vref DAC Range0 -- BP_VREF = Hi-Z 2'b01 - Reserved Encoding 2'b10 - PHY Vref DAC Range0 -- BP_VREF connected to PLL Analog Bus 2'b11 - PHY Vref DAC Range0 -- BP_VREF connected to PHY Vref DAC ========================================================== GlobalVrefInSel[2] shall be set according to Dram Protocol: Protocol GlobalVrefInSel[2] ------------------------------------------ DDR3 1'b0 DDR4 1'b0 LPDDR3 1'b0 LPDDR4 1'b1

field.name: GlobalVrefInDAC
field.description: DAC code for internal Vref generation The DAC has two ranges; the range is set by GlobalVrefInSel[2] ========================================================== RANGE0 : DDR3,DDR4,LPDDR3 [GlobalVrefInSel[2] = 0] DAC Output Voltage = GlobalVrefInDAC == 6'h00 ? Hi-Z : 0.
